_about: The Plane of Eternal Chaos (levels 29-50): imps, spawn, hell hounds and lesser demons who answer each other, chaos cultists, the chaos horror, the succubus and the pit fiend as elites, the balor on the Spire Summit a sub-boss, and Kaleidos the Prismatic Dragon breathing every colour of ruin while the plane's light flickers out.

796600.name: xarvoth demon lord
796600.long_desc: Xarvoth the Demon Lord sits upon a throne of bone and iron, plotting conquest.
796600.description: A towering fiend of black iron hide and red-veined horn, its wings folded like a cloak over the back of the throne. Burning eyes move over maps of a world it means to take, and the air around it shimmers with heat and hatred. The chaos host that pours through this plane is its army, and every demon here answers to its voice.
796600.why: the demon lord who commands the invasion, on his throne

phases.message: Xarvoth rises from the throne, wings spread wide: "KNEEL!"
